Main Case No: Crl.P.No. 13359 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Office
 Date Order

Dr.YLR,J  Heard Sri K. Chidambaram, learned Senior  Counsel, representing SriJamadagni Chittala,
 learned counsel for the Petitioners.
It is the allegation of the defacto  complainant, who is a Doctor by profession that

the Petitioners have taken Rs. 75,00,000/- on  various dates, through RTGS transactions for the  purpose of investing them in Real Estate  Business, but the Petitioners have cheated the  defacto complainant.
The defacto complainant filed a complaint  before the jurisdictional Magistrate, who directed  the SHO, Pattabhipuram Police Station, Guntur to  register a case.

Accordingly, the Police registered  a case in FIR No.446 of 2025 for the offences  punishable under Section 452, 420, 120(b), 506  read with 34 of IPC, corresponding to Sections  333, 318(1)(f), 61(2), 351(2),(3) read with Section  3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
The defacto complainant alleges that he  gave a report to the SHO, Pattabhipuram Police  Station, who gave a receipt, but he did not  register any case.

2  The complaint presented by the Petitioner before jurisdictional Magistrate states that he gave a complaint to the Inspector General of Police, South Central Zone, Guntur on 06.09.2025, who inturn forwarded the same to the Superintendent of Police, Guntur, directing him to take necessary legal action against the Accused.
It appears that no civil suit was filed by the defacto complainant against the Petitioners for recovery of the amounts.
